question: T1

original_knowledge.text: The newly added 'Admissible Actions' clause requires verifying that a navigation or manipulation command is present in the current admissible list before issuing it, and using a listed direct action on a receptacle when the desired navigation destination is absent. In the observed runs this was not reliably followed: the Candidate still issued navigation commands absent from the admissible list—'go to cabinet 3' from cabinet 1 (Q8:39) and 'go to drawer 8' from drawer 7 (Q7:25)—each returning 'Nothing happens', and the Parent likewise issued an inadmissible 'go to cabinet 1' from cabinet 3 (P8:15). No observed step shows the intended direct-action fallback producing progress, and both put-a-clean-soapbar-in-cabinet runs still ended at the 50-step limit (P8:50, Q8:50).

p6_assessment: Q7:25 动作/轮次错配；Evidence 引用存在但不支持动作陈述。
diagnostic_comparison: A/B 各两次均能准确绑定两个事件。
limitation: Directed questions and complete Replay are different tasks; not a single-variable causal contrast.

question: T3

original_knowledge.text: The current diff adds three things to the desklamp skill's general non-desklamp procedure—an 'Admissible Actions' verification clause, a broadened/anti-cycling search step, and a strengthened exact-target/no-substitute step—so its observed response is a joint intervention and cannot be credited to a single clause. Across the 10 verified pairs, task-level success was unchanged: both the pre-edit Parent and the edited Candidate succeeded on 8 tasks, and both hit the 50-step limit on the same two tasks (clean-some-butterknife-and-put-it-in-drawer; put-a-clean-soapbar-in-cabinet). Step counts moved in both directions (Candidate 6 vs 5 in examine-the-pillow-with-the-desklamp and put-some-pencil-on-desk; 11 vs 14 in cool-some-apple-and-put-it-in-microwave), so no clause is isolated and no task-level improvement or regression is demonstrated in this single trial per task.

The revised search step directs the Actor to include visible open surfaces, to prefer a still-untried receptacle type after exhausting one type, and not to re-enter a location just left or repeat a short cycle. The observed response is mixed. Consistent with the clause, in the put-a-clean-soapbar-in-cabinet pair the Candidate visited receptacle types the Parent never reached—bathtubbasin 1 (Q8:3) and sinkbasin 2 (Q8:19)—yet the requested soapbar was not found and both sides still hit the step limit (P8:50, Q8:50). The clause did not break the cycling failure mode: in the clean-butterknife-in-drawer and soapbar-in-cabinet pairs both sides still shuttled among the same receptacles to the 50-step limit (P7:50, Q7:50). In two tasks where the target was found the Candidate spent an extra initial navigation step (Q2:1, Q5:1), giving 6 vs 5 steps, though that inefficiency is not individually isolated.

p6_assessment: 把全局条款并入 non-desklamp，并用 pillow 响应评价搜索。
diagnostic_comparison: 四次事实/条件部分均读出章节边界；B 两次在结论混淆无违规和未执行/不适用。
limitation: Directed questions and complete Replay are different tasks; not a single-variable causal contrast.

question: T4

original_knowledge.text: The revised step 2 states that when the exact requested noun has not been observed, a different but related object must not be acquired, cleaned, cooled, heated, or placed, and that a container holding only a non-matching object should be left unmanipulated. A counterexample appeared in the clean-some-butterknife-and-put-it-in-drawer task: no butterknife was observed, yet the Candidate took a knife from drawer 1 (Q7:9, Q7:13), cleaned it (Q7:17) and moved it to drawer 1 (Q7:19), i.e., it substituted a related object despite the strengthened rule, and the run still ended at the 50-step limit (Q7:50); the Parent substituted the same knife (P7:8, P7:12). In the put-a-clean-soapbar-in-cabinet task the exact soapbar was likewise absent and the Candidate left the visible near-miss soapbottle/spraybottle at cabinet 2 untaken (seen at Q8:7, never taken), but the Parent also abstained there, so that pair does not distinguish the clause.

diagnostic_comparison: 四次均保留未找到与全局未知；A2 新增 candle 3 位置混写。
limitation: Directed questions and complete Replay are different tasks; not a single-variable causal contrast.

question: T4

original_knowledge.text: The refinement did not reliably stop step-limit cycling when the exact target was not found. In current val:0013 (heat apple to diningtable), both Parent and Candidate ended at the 50-step limit; the Candidate repeatedly cycled among fridge1, countertop1, countertop2, cabinet1 and cabinet2 (Q3:12, Q3:16, Q3:33, Q3:38) and did not move to the several available uninspected cabinets or diningtable candidates, so no apple was acquired or heated. Historical S1_R05/Q7 likewise failed at 50 while cycling drawers, countertops and cabinets when no exact butterknife was present, matching S1_R05/P7's failure (S1_R05/P7:50, S1_R05/Q7:50). In S1_R05/P10/Q10 both succeeded on cool-apple-to-microwave, but the Candidate needed 46 steps versus the Parent's 38 and revisited many already-seen empty locations before reaching diningtable at Q10:40 (S1_R05/P10:32, S1_R05/P10:38; S1_R05/Q10:38, S1_R05/Q10:40, S1_R05/Q10:46). Thus the evidence supports the anti-cycling instruction only as an occasional, not reliable, response; it does not overcome search failure or prevent inefficient revisits.

p6_assessment: 继承 M10 no exact butterknife was present，未校准解释强度。
diagnostic_comparison: 四次均明确全球不存在未证明，但对旧解释纠正程度不一致，A1 search/absence、A2 rescue 套用仍含混。
limitation: Directed questions and complete Replay are different tasks; not a single-variable causal contrast.

question: T5

original_knowledge.text: The temperature guidance had no opportunity to help when the exact target was not acquired, and it does not repair search failures. In current val:0013 (heat apple to diningtable), both executions hit the 50-step limit without an apple or any heat action, despite available cabinets and diningtable candidates (P3:50, Q3:50; Q3:12, Q3:16). In the historical S1_R04 heat-plate pair, Parent found the plate on countertop3, heated it and succeeded in 13 steps (S1_R04/P2:4, P2:11, P2:13), while Candidate never reached countertop3, hit the 50-step limit and never had a temperature opportunity (S1_R04/Q2:50). In the historical S1_R04 hot-mug pair the exact mug was not acquired; Parent took a cup near-match at P1:28 and both eventually hit 50 (S1_R04/P1:50; S1_R04/Q1:50), while in the S1_R03 heat-mug pair both hit 50 with no exact mug acquired and the Candidate did not substitute a cup (S1_R03/P10:50; S1_R03/Q10:36, Q10:50). These cases show the guidance is conditional on exact-target discovery and say nothing supportive about success when the target is absent or unlocated.

p6_assessment: 成功保留 13 成功/50 失败及机会不对称。
diagnostic_comparison: 四次均保留；B1 条件化 savings 过强，A2 no observable effect 过宽，B2 边界较清晰。
limitation: Directed questions and complete Replay are different tasks; not a single-variable causal contrast.

question: T6

original_knowledge.text: The current search refinement—treating each individual closed container and open surface as a separate candidate, not treating a container family as exhausted after one or two empty members, leaving already-open/known-empty locations immediately, and continuing to new candidates when the same small set recurs—was associated with rescues only when the Actor actually reached an uninspected surface or family. In current val:0016 (put two books in desk), the Parent stayed among desk, shelves, drawers and sidetable and hit the 50-step limit (P6:50), whereas the Candidate reached bed1 at step33, took book1, placed it in desk, returned to bed1 for book2, and completed at step40 (Q6:33, Q6:34, Q6:36, Q6:38, Q6:40). In current val:0012 (cool tomato to microwave), the Parent cycled among fridge, countertops and cabinet before reaching countertop2 at step12 and succeeding at step18, while the Candidate reached countertop2 at step4 and succeeded in 10 (P2:12, P2:15, P2:18; Q2:4, Q2:7, Q2:10). Historical family-sweep pairs show the same conditional pattern: S1_R05/P6 hit 50 without checking countertop2, while Q6 checked countertop2 at step16, found the exact butterknife, cleaned it and placed it successfully (S1_R05/P6:50; S1_R05/Q6:16, S1_R05/Q6:19, S1_R05/Q6:21); S1_R05/P8 hit 50 after cycling cabinets, sinkbasin and countertop, while Q8 checked shelf1 at step18, found the exact soapbar, cleaned and placed it (S1_R05/P8:50; S1_R05/Q8:18, S1_R05/Q8:19, S1_R05/Q8:21, S1_R05/Q8:23). These comparisons support benefit from expanding to uninspected candidates, but each task was run once and the current edit was applied jointly with the temperature clause, so whole-task differences are not attributable to this search text alone.

Successive temperature-conditioning guidance—including the current step to perform the explicit cool/heat action on the held target as soon as it is admissible, opening the appliance only when necessary and avoiding repeated insert/remove or door toggling—was followed and successful in current tasks after the exact target was acquired. In val:0014 (heat tomato to fridge), Parent P4 inserted the tomato, repeatedly closed/reopened the microwave, took it out, heated it, and placed it in 39 steps (P4:6, P4:19, P4:39), while Candidate Q4 heated the held tomato at the closed microwave at step6 and completed in 8 steps (Q4:5, Q4:8). In val:0015, Parent P5 opened the microwave before heating and finished in 8 steps (P5:4, P5:5), while Candidate Q5 heated the held tomato at the closed microwave and finished in 7 (Q5:4, Q5:7). In val:0011, Candidate Q1 cooled the plate with the closed fridge at step7 and succeeded, although it took 9 steps versus Parent's 8 because it first opened cabinet1 (Q1:2, Q1:7, Q1:9; P1:5, P1:6, P1:8). In val:0012, both used direct cool actions on the held tomato at the open fridge, and Candidate's 10-step success versus Parent's 18 was mainly a search difference (Q2:7, Q2:10; P2:15, P2:18). Earlier paired cases with the target acquired showed the same direction: cool pot 18 vs 11 steps with P opening the fridge and Q cooling at the closed fridge (S1_R03/P7:15, P7:16, P7:18; S1_R03/Q7:9, Q7:11), hot apple 35 vs 9 with P inserting/toggling and Q heating held at the closed microwave (S1_R03/P8:19, P8:20, P8:33, P8:35; S1_R03/Q8:7, Q8:9), heat egg 40 vs 15 (S1_R03/P9:24, P9:37, P9:40; S1_R03/Q9:13, Q9:15), hot potato 14 vs 7 (S1_R04/P3:8, P3:12, P3:14; S1_R04/Q3:5, Q3:7), and heat tomato 21 vs 7 (S1_R04/P4:6, P4:19, P4:21; S1_R04/Q4:5, Q4:7). This supports reduced appliance manipulation and step savings conditional on locating the exact target, not a guarantee of whole-task savings when search differs.

p6_assessment: 正确区分温变相同、整体搜索差异。
diagnostic_comparison: 四次保持核心比较；B1 出现不存在的 Q2:40/Q2:11，B2 将三步 placement 写成五步。
limitation: Directed questions and complete Replay are different tasks; not a single-variable causal contrast.
